cells.value: Very few incidents of decompression damage have occurred in oil production conditions up to and including operations at 4000 psi, 200°F and 12% CO₂ in the associated gas.

Failures have occurred in 70 durometer Viton® compressor seals handling gas with 12% CO₂ at 4000 psi and 300°F. 90 durometer Viton® or AFLAS fluoroelastomer seals are working satisfactorily with periodic replacement.

Failures have occurred in Viton®, Buna-N, Hydrin®, EP, and large EPDM seals in equipment from some manufacturers. Other manufacturers are using the same elastomers successfully in the same situations.

Failures have occurred in all elastomers; however, a large portion of equipment is operating successfully with peroxide cured Buna-N, Hydrin®, and EPDM seals. The success of these seals is largely dependent upon the manufacturer's design of seal assembly.
This sealing application is at the edge of elastomer technology and is a research effort for any manufacturer.
